title: Staff Software Engineer (Journeys)
description: 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. About engineering at Headway: Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!). Principles that guide us: Focus on the mission : We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapists to better solve the problems they’re facing. Ship small, learn fast : We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration Everything is a product : Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end-users in mind. Optimize for trust : We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes. Tools we use: Languages: Python 3, TypeScript Libraries & Frameworks: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React, Remix, Next.js Datastores: Postgres, Redis Infrastructure: AWS (Fargate, ECS, S3, and more), Spark and Kafka Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry Version Control: Github, PagerDuty Vulnerability Management : Snyk, Semgrep Cloud Security: Lacework Delivery : Knock (transactional + product notifications), Iterable (lifecycle marketing + campaigns), Twilio, Mailgun About the Journey Team at Headway The Journey team powers how Headway reaches every patient and provider at the right moment, on the right channel - email, SMS and other communication channels. We’re building the next chapter: an agentic communications engine that learns which message, which channel, and which timing works best for each person — and gets smarter with every send. We own the full stack: from the delivery layer (Knock for transactional, Iterable for lifecycle), to the decision engine we’re building today. This is a senior IC role — the person who owns the architecture of how Headway communicates at scale. You’ll design and evolve the decision engine, experimentation layer, and channel orchestration that will define how Headway reaches patients and providers for years to come. You’ll set the technical direction for a multi-vendor communications stack, own the unified message ledger, and bring LLM-powered personalization from concept to production. This role is high-leverage and cross-functional.     • A systems thinker who holds the architecture of a complex, multi-vendor platform and guides the team through it

Tools we use: Languages: Python 3, TypeScript Libraries & Frameworks: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React, Remix Experimentation & Analytics: LaunchDarkly, Statsig, dbt, Snowflake Datastores: Postgres, Redis Infrastructure: AWS (Fargate, ECS, S3, and more), Cloudflare, Spark and Kafka Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry Version Control: Github About the role We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own how Headway runs experiments. "Ship small, learn fast" is the second principle on the list above, and experimentation is how we actually do it: eleven teams have run hundreds of experiments deciding how patients find a therapist, how quickly new providers get up and running, whether our AI products are working, and how we collect the clinical outcomes data that proves care is effective. You will own the platform all of that runs on. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with unusually wide reach. You will design and build the core primitives, including how users are assigned to experiments, how we record what someone actually saw, and how we recognize the same person across devices and between browsing anonymously and signing in. You will decide what our long-term experimentation and feature flagging stack should be; we run LaunchDarkly and Statsig today, and that architecture is yours to evaluate and consolidate. You will also make AI a real part of the workflow, from validating an experiment's setup before it starts to catching a broken experiment automatically instead of discovering it in a Slack thread a week later. You will also evolve our experimentation capabilities to expand into market-based testing. Headway is a multi-sided marketplace, so we frequently need to change something for therapists and measure what happens to patients, which changes both how a test must be designed and how it can be analyzed. We need to test whole geographic markets, not just individual users. We need to hold groups out for long stretches to understand real long-term impact. These capabilities are well understood in the industry and we have not built them yet, and they are the ones our business needs next. The job is a platform and a program in equal measure. Half of it is the technical foundation. The other half is raising how well the whole company experiments: the defaults, the review, the documentation, and the education that let a team run a trustworthy experiment without needing you in the room. You will gather needs from teams who all want something different, sequence them into a roadmap, and say no clearly, which means acting as part technical product manager for your own platform. You will sit in the Patient org, where the highest volume of experiments happens, and serve the whole company. Trustworthy results are shared ownership. You will own assignment, exposure, and the experiment data pipelines, which are the parts of the chain that are engineering problems. You will work closely with Data Science, who own statistical methodology, and with the teams who own our event tracking and metric definitions, because a number is only as trustworthy as the weakest link in that chain. Who you are We are looking for a Staff level engineer who wants their impact measured by what other teams can now do. You think in systems, you are uncomfortable with numbers you cannot explain, and you raise the bar for the people around you. You have owned an experimentation or feature flagging stack end to end rather than only used one. Whether you built it from first principles or built the missing pieces on top of a vendor matters far less to us than having been accountable for whether the results were correct. You have built the parts that do not come out of the box: assignment that persists correctly, exposure that reflects what a user actually saw, identity resolved across sessions and devices, or the diagnostics that catch a broken experiment early. You are fluent enough in the statistics to be a real partner to data scientists. You can tell the difference between a result that is weak and a result that is invalid, and you can hold your position on a measurement question with someone who does this full time. You have debugged the hard class of measurement bugs: traffic that split unevenly, users who ended up in both arms, effects that vanished once you looked at who was actually exposed, identity that broke between anonymous and logged-in sessions. You have built a program and not only a platform. You have measurably raised how well an organization experiments through defaults, templates, review, and teaching, not only through code. You have made a build versus buy call on a platform and lived with it. You can reason about vendor risk and about where a warehouse-native approach beats a hosted one. You have landed a migration on teams that did not ask for one, by making the new path easier than the old path rather than by mandate. You use AI as genuine leverage in your work and you have clear opinions about where it must not be trusted without a human. You have driven technical direction beyond your own team through design documents, reviews, and planning cycles, and you regularly mentor senior engineers. You are willing to flex across the stack. This role touches backend services, front end rendering, CDN behavior, and the data warehouse. Experience with multi-sided marketplaces, growth or search and ranking systems, or healthcare is a plus, though none is required. Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave. title: German Advertising Reviewer
description: Location: Spain, Remote (Work from Home) Type: Freelance, Part-time, Flexible Hours About the Role: We are looking for a passionate and tech-savvy individual to join our team as a German Advertising Reviewer. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and grading internet advertisements to ensure they are relevant, accurate, and delivered effectively to end users. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves surfing the internet, uses major search engines frequently, and enjoys understanding what people want based on a few keywords. If you enjoy researching topics online and want a flexible and fun side job, this position is perfect for you! Key Responsibilities: - Evaluate the quality and relevance of online advertisements in German. - Assess ad content and placement to ensure they meet specific criteria and guidelines. - Provide feedback and suggestions to improve ad quality and effectiveness. - Conduct keyword research to understand user intent and enhance ad targeting. - Collaborate with the team to identify trends and improve ad delivery strategies. Qualifications: - Native-level in German and strong understanding of German culture and online trends. - Proficiency in English for communication and reporting purposes. - Regular user of major search engines and social media platforms. - Excellent research skills and ability to analyze information quickly. - Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Reliable internet connection and a suitable home working environment. Ideal Candidate: - Surfs the internet daily and is familiar with various online platforms. - Has experience using major search engines like Google, Bing, etc. - Understands what people want based on minimal information or keywords. - Enjoys researching and learning about new topics online. - Seeks a flexible, remote job that can be balanced with other commitments. Benefits: - Flexible working hours that fit your schedule. - Work from the comfort of your home (based in Spain). - Gain insights into the digital advertising industry. - Enhance your research and analytical skills. - Be part of a dynamic and supportive team. How to Apply: If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume by clicking apply below, we look forward to hearing from you! Compensation Additional Information About Welocalize Welocalize is an award-winning global data and translation company with offices across the world. We’ve quietly worked on some of the biggest tech projects in history, from data localization and translation to generative AI and deep learning. When you join Welocalize, you’ll have the opportunity to bring your career to the next level: - Structured learning opportunities that grow your skills, knowledge, and specialties - 24-hour, 6-day-a--week real human support from our Community Experience Team - Access to long-term partnerships and unique projects across a variety of industries and content types - Corporate and executive career opportunities to bolster your resume and grow your career

About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Ukrainian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Ukrainian

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Ukrainian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

Compensation

Additional Information

About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Slovak Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Slovak (Slovakia)

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Slovak and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation

Additional Information

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Demo Engineer
description: About this role As Ashby ’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored — the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. That doesn’t scale: reps lose selling time, demos drift out of date, and every new product release widens the gap between what Ashby can do and what we can actually show live. Your job is to close that gap. This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation — customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams. Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program — release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with. The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical — working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation — who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time. You could be a great fit if: 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments. 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time. 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support. 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect. 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field. 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup. ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you. 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally — with Engineering and with GTM — and can translate their needs into reliable systems. 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into. Bonus points for: 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before. 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale. 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on. 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations. Examples of things you’ll work on: 🧱 Own the scaled demo system — customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team. 🗂 Generate realistic demo data — standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup. 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos — create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally. 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases — make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA. 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments — create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby during the sales cycle. 📚 Document how it all works — maintain clear documentation so the GTM team knows when and how to use each demo environment. Why become a Demo Engineer at Ashby? You’ll define a role that doesn’t exist yet. This is a net-new role designed around a real business need. You won’t inherit a mature playbook — you’ll build the infrastructure that lets the whole GTM team demo at a higher level. Your work will compound. A great live demo helps one deal. A reliable, current, well-documented demo system improves every demo the entire go-to-market team runs. If you like creating leverage, this role has a lot of it. The product gives you something real to work with. Ashby has strong product-market fit, and that matters here. You’re not manufacturing excitement around a weak product — you’re making it effortless to show something that already resonates when it’s shown well. You’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering and GTM. This is a rare blend of technical building and understanding what the field actually needs. You’ll help translate our product releases into live deals — and connect the two. The surface area keeps growing. As we ship new features and expand into new product areas, new verticals, and new geographies, demo needs compound with each release. There is a lot to build, and it only gets more interesting. Reasons you shouldn’t apply: If you want to be customer-facing or closing deals, this isn’t the right role — the impact here happens behind the scenes. If you’re not genuinely hands-on technical — comfortable in JSON, APIs, and data — the core of this job will be frustrating. If you need a fully built environment and a finished playbook, the ambiguity of a 0→1 role with infrastructure still being built will feel uncomfortable. If continuously maintaining and updating environments as the product changes sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this won’t be a fit. If you’d rather build production product features than internal tooling and demo systems, you’ll likely want a different engineering role. Interview Process Our interview process is thorough — we want to make sure this role is the right fit for you and that you’re the right fit for Ashby. Details on the process for this role will be shared by your recruiter. Benefits You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible. Sell a product that our customers are truly excited about. Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive! 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable. $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. About Ashby We’re building the next generation of recruiting software and we’re starting with a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run an efficient and data-driven hiring process. We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation — customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams.

Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program — release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with.

The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical — working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation — who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments.

  • 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time.

  • 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support.

  • 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect.

  • 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field.

  • 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup.

  • ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you.

  • 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally — with Engineering and with GTM — and can translate their needs into reliable systems.

  • 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into.

Bonus points for:

  • 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before.

  • 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale.

  • 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on.

  • 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations.

Examples of things you’ll work on:

  • 🧱 Own the scaled demo system — customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team.

  • 🗂 Generate realistic demo data — standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup.

  • 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos — create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally.

  • 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases — make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA.

  • 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments — create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby during the sales cycle.

  • 📚 Document how it all works — maintain clear documentation so the GTM team knows when and how to use each demo environment.

Why become a Demo Engineer at Ashby?

You’ll define a role that doesn’t exist yet. This is a net-new role designed around a real business need. You won’t inherit a mature playbook — you’ll build the infrastructure that lets the whole GTM team demo at a higher level.

Your work will compound. A great live demo helps one deal. A reliable, current, well-documented demo system improves every demo the entire go-to-market team runs. If you like creating leverage, this role has a lot of it.

The product gives you something real to work with. Ashby has strong product-market fit, and that matters here. You’re not manufacturing excitement around a weak product — you’re making it effortless to show something that already resonates when it’s shown well.

You’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering and GTM. This is a rare blend of technical building and understanding what the field actually needs. You’ll help translate our product releases into live deals — and connect the two.

The surface area keeps growing. As we ship new features and expand into new product areas, new verticals, and new geographies, demo needs compound with each release. There is a lot to build, and it only gets more interesting.

Reasons you shouldn’t apply:

  • If you want to be customer-facing or closing deals, this isn’t the right role — the impact here happens behind the scenes.

  • If you’re not genuinely hands-on technical — comfortable in JSON, APIs, and data — the core of this job will be frustrating.

  • If you need a fully built environment and a finished playbook, the ambiguity of a 0→1 role with infrastructure still being built will feel uncomfortable.

  • If continuously maintaining and updating environments as the product changes sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this won’t be a fit.

  • If you’d rather build production product features than internal tooling and demo systems, you’ll likely want a different engineering role.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we want to make sure this role is the right fit for you and that you’re the right fit for Ashby. Details on the process for this role will be shared by your recruiter.

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • Sell a product that our customers are truly excited about.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of recruiting software and we’re starting with a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run an efficient and data-driven hiring process.

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!).

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

title: Junior Data Specialist
description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. ABOUT THE ROLE The Jr. Data Specialist is the accuracy backbone of every standard website build. You take scraped, client-provided, and MLS-fed content into our CMS and turn it into a complete, correct, and compliant site — ensuring the site foundation is technically sound before it reaches the design phase. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Content Accuracy & Verification Quality Assurance: Review and validate all data for accuracy and completeness before submission or approval. Data Accuracy: Verify names, titles, contact information, addresses, statistics, awards, and credentials against authoritative source materials before entering data. Content Quality: Review all website content for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and formatting accuracy across agent profiles, neighborhood pages, blogs, developments, testimonials, and other client-facing content. Site Data Population Agent Profile Management: Populate and maintain agent profiles by accurately entering biographies, headshots, social media links and display order, email addresses, phone numbers, license numbers, and image alt text. Property Management: Maintain accurate property listings, including MLS synchronization, manually uploaded images, placeholder logos, and functional property links, tours, and videos. Neighborhood & Development Pages: Ensure neighborhood and development pages are complete and accurate, including descriptions, heading structure, hyperlinks, and map boundaries. Content Management: Organize blogs and press content chronologically, remove duplicate testimonials, and keep client logos accurate and up to date. Compliance & Standards Compliance Requirements: Ensure website content complies with applicable state, MLS, and brokerage requirements by implementing required disclosures, licensing information, Realtor® trademark usage, and state-required license numbers. Responsive QA: Verify that all detail pages are fully responsive, visually consistent, and easy to navigate across mobile and tablet devices. Process & Communication Task Management: Own the timely delivery of assigned work by meeting the team's handling-time expectations and maintaining accurate task statuses that reflect current project progress. Self-QA Before Handoff: Complete the DS Self-QA standards before handing work to QA — every source-of-truth request confirmed, compliance checked, data and links verified. Work is not handed off until it is genuinely complete. On-Time Ownership: Own the delivery timeline of your assigned tasks, and resolve QA passbacks promptly so the project keeps moving. Reporting: Flag recurring source errors, missing documentation, or MLS/feed issues to your Team Lead or a Data Specialist/Senior Data Specialist. Raise Risk Early: Communicate workload, dependency, or delivery risk before a deadline is missed — not after. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience 0-1 years of experience with data entry, content management, or web content QA. Extreme precision in proofreading and data mapping. High technical aptitude for learning new CMS logic and property-feed behavior. Familiarity with a CMS/back-end platform (WordPress-like) is a plus Fresh graduates encouraged to apply — training provided Skills & Mindset Meticulous attention to detail and a strong cross-referencing habit Strong written English (spelling, grammar, punctuation) Google searching and Google Apps proficiency Reliable, quick learner, strong work ethic, thinks like an owner Core Values Professionalism – Show up prepared, respectful, and dependable. Ownership – Take responsibility for outcomes and follow through. Communication – Be proactive, transparent, and timely. Collaboration – Work well with others and contribute to team success. Excellence – Deliver high-quality work with attention to detail. Adaptability – Thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment. Integrity – Do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Never mark QA notes or tasks complete before the work is actually implemented. OTHER REQUIREMENTS Must be a Philippine resident Must be willing to work during graveyard hours Must own a laptop or desktop Must have a valid government ID Must have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired Must have a stable internet connection that is at least 100 mbps and have a back-up connection Must live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

At Masabi, we’re powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible and seamless.

We’re building our next data platform. Our ticketing, validation and payment services already publish events to Kafka, and over the coming year we’re turning those events into a governed lakehouse on AWS that transit agencies, internal teams and our APIs can query. It will replace our current Elasticsearch-based data store.

You’ll join a small Data team of software engineers who design as well as build: choosing approaches, measuring performance and cost, and writing your choices down. You’ll bring software engineering practices to a data platform, from well-tested services and CI checks to infrastructure as code. What you build will shape how agencies and our own teams use their data.

Location_

This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and run the services that ingest Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables on AWS, including partitioning, compaction, deduplication and backfills of historical data

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, using AI tools with good judgement, and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Work with the teams that produce the data on data contracts, including Avro schemas with field-level classification, schema evolution rules and the CI checks that enforce them

  • Build privacy and access into the platform: personal data erasure, retention and per-agency access control

  • Build the query layer behind our customer-facing data API, and give others access through Athena

  • Evaluate technical approaches, measure performance and cost, and document the choices you make

  • Migrate existing dashboards, reports and finance extracts onto the new platform

  • Later, build the curated layer of shared metrics and business-ready datasets for BI tools and an AI analytics assistant

About You_

What you’ll need:

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: you write production code, test it properly and work comfortably with Git and CI pipelines

  • AI fluency: you use AI coding tools daily and check their output carefully, especially for SQL, schema changes and anything that affects data correctness

  • Good SQL and some experience building or running data pipelines, so you’re comfortable working with data from source to query

  • A solid grasp of data modelling

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

What will help you thrive:

  • Experience running a lakehouse or data warehouse in production

  • Production experience with Kafka and schemas (ideally Avro)

  • Experience handling personal data, including privacy, retention and access control

  • You’re comfortable making design decisions and explaining the trade-offs, in writing as well as in conversation

  • You enjoy working closely with the teams that produce the data, not just the ones that use it

  • Nice to have: JVM experience (Kotlin or Java), Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS Lake Formation, DuckDB

We don’t expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You’ll Learn_

  • How to build a data platform from the ground up for a global fare payment platform used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse stack: Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation, Kafka and Avro on AWS

  • How to shape technical direction in a small team, where your design choices and write-ups set the standard

  • How to use AI tools well in real engineering work, in a team that encourages them and cares about getting the results right

Our Stack_

  • Java or Kotlin

  • AWS: S3, Apache Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation (and potentially more query engines)

  • PostgreSQL, DuckDB

  • Kafka with Avro

  • Terraform, GitLab CI

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: Embedded AI Engineer, On-Device Models
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and we have deep machinery for running them on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers need them on everything else: non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, mobile application processors, DSPs and NPUs, and purpose-built devices with tight memory, compute, thermal, and power budgets. When a target platform's standard kernels and runtime can't run a Deepgram model well enough, someone has to go below them. That is this role. As an Embedded AI Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you work at the lowest layer of our edge stack. You write and optimize custom kernels and operators for specific hardware, collapse models onto device-specific execution units, and do the target-side quantization and assembly-level tuning that standard toolchains can't. You hand what you build up to Applied ML Engineers, who fit Deepgram models to your kernels. Your work is what makes a new hardware platform viable for Deepgram at all. This role is a great fit for a senior embedded engineer who has spent their career close to the metal and wants to point that at speech AI, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram's models get onto new silicon. We'll set the level to your experience. What You'll Do Write and optimize custom kernels and operators (C, C++, Rust, and platform assembly or intrinsics) for non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, DSPs, and NPUs where the vendor's standard operator set is insufficient for Deepgram models. Own target-side optimization: collapse models onto device execution units through quantization, operator fusion, memory layout, and architecture-specific compilation to meet latency, memory, power, and thermal budgets. Integrate with vendor NPU/DSP toolchains and edge inference runtimes, and extend them with custom operators when the graph doesn't map cleanly. Deliver kernels and runtime components as reusable building blocks that Applied ML Engineers can target when adapting models, with clear interfaces and documented constraints. Build performance-critical runtime code for embedded environments, including embedded Linux, bare-metal, and RTOS targets. Establish per-platform benchmarking and validation for latency, accuracy, power, memory footprint, and utilization, and catch regressions before they ship. Partner with silicon and platform vendors on SDK integration and low-level performance tuning for new chipsets and reference platforms. Feed hardware constraints back to Applied ML and Research so model designs are easier to land on constrained targets. You'll Love This Role If You Find deep satisfaction in making a large model run on hardware that was never meant to run it, and still hitting accuracy and latency targets. Reach for the profiler and the ISA manual before you reach for a bigger chip. Would rather write the kernel than wait for the vendor to ship it. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold start, power draw, thermals, memory fragmentation, cache behavior. Prefer hard, constrained, ship-it problems over open-ended research. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold-start time, power draw, thermals, and memory fragmentation. It's Important To Us That You Have Experience delivering production systems on resource-constrained hardware — embedded systems, mobile, edge AI, or small low-power devices. Strong proficiency in C, C++, and/or Rust, with experience writing performance-critical code for constrained environments. Hands-on experience with model optimization for on-device deployment, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, or architecture-specific compilation. Familiarity with edge inference runtimes (e.g., ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, ExecuTorch) and/or vendor-specific NPU/DSP toolchains. A strong understanding of hardware-software interaction — CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP architectures, memory hierarchies, fixed-point/integer arithmetic, and power management — and how they affect inference performance. Experience working close to the metal: bare-metal or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), embedded Linux, or microcontroller and edge SoC development. Strong communication skills and a builder mindset — you can scope an ambiguous optimization problem, drive it to a measurable result, and explain the tradeoffs clearly. It Would Be Great if You Had Experience with real-time audio processing on embedded platforms — DSP pipelines, audio codec optimization, wake-word or always-on listening, or streaming inference on microcontrollers and edge SoCs. Depth in ML optimization techniques — custom quantization schemes, mixed-precision inference, or neural architecture search for edge targets. Background in hardware evaluation and benchmarking — systematically comparing accelerators, SoCs, or GPUs for specific workload profiles. Experience shipping AI features in consumer products at scale, and the instinct for what "production quality" means on a battery-powered device. Familiarity with model compilation and optimization toolchains and their tradeoffs across hardware targets. Experience with secure, robust on-device deployment practices — code signing, encrypted model storage, and safe update mechanisms. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

  • Integrate with vendor NPU/DSP toolchains and edge inference runtimes, and extend them with custom operators when the graph doesn't map cleanly.

  • Deliver kernels and runtime components as reusable building blocks that Applied ML Engineers can target when adapting models, with clear interfaces and documented constraints.

  • Build performance-critical runtime code for embedded environments, including embedded Linux, bare-metal, and RTOS targets.

  • Establish per-platform benchmarking and validation for latency, accuracy, power, memory footprint, and utilization, and catch regressions before they ship.

  • Partner with silicon and platform vendors on SDK integration and low-level performance tuning for new chipsets and reference platforms.

  • Feed hardware constraints back to Applied ML and Research so model designs are easier to land on constrained targets.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Find deep satisfaction in making a large model run on hardware that was never meant to run it, and still hitting accuracy and latency targets.

  • Reach for the profiler and the ISA manual before you reach for a bigger chip.

  • Would rather write the kernel than wait for the vendor to ship it.

  • Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold start, power draw, thermals, memory fragmentation, cache behavior.

  • Prefer hard, constrained, ship-it problems over open-ended research.

  • Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold-start time, power draw, thermals, and memory fragmentation.

It's Important To Us That You Have

  • Experience delivering production systems on resource-constrained hardware — embedded systems, mobile, edge AI, or small low-power devices.

  • Strong proficiency in C, C++, and/or Rust, with experience writing performance-critical code for constrained environments.

  • Hands-on experience with model optimization for on-device deployment, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, or architecture-specific compilation.

  • Familiarity with edge inference runtimes (e.g., ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, ExecuTorch) and/or vendor-specific NPU/DSP toolchains.

  • A strong understanding of hardware-software interaction — CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP architectures, memory hierarchies, fixed-point/integer arithmetic, and power management — and how they affect inference performance.

  • Experience working close to the metal: bare-metal or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), embedded Linux, or microcontroller and edge SoC development.

  • Strong communication skills and a builder mindset — you can scope an ambiguous optimization problem, drive it to a measurable result, and explain the tradeoffs clearly.

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Experience with real-time audio processing on embedded platforms — DSP pipelines, audio codec optimization, wake-word or always-on listening, or streaming inference on microcontrollers and edge SoCs.

  • Depth in ML optimization techniques — custom quantization schemes, mixed-precision inference, or neural architecture search for edge targets.

  • Background in hardware evaluation and benchmarking — systematically comparing accelerators, SoCs, or GPUs for specific workload profiles.

  • Experience shipping AI features in consumer products at scale, and the instinct for what "production quality" means on a battery-powered device.

  • Familiarity with model compilation and optimization toolchains and their tradeoffs across hardware targets.

  • Experience with secure, robust on-device deployment practices — code signing, encrypted model storage, and safe update mechanisms.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.
